entities.summary: Manuel da Silva Rosa (b. 1961, Pico Island) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Pico Island and Portugal. Known in the fields of portugal, composers & musicians, europe.
